book.title: Modern Robotics: Mechanics, Planning, and Control
book.authors: Kevin M. Lynch & Frank C. Park
book.usage: Concept and section-number reference only; all lesson wording is original.
book.tocNote: Section numbers verified against the reconstructed v2 table of contents supplied by the TOC step (PDF download was blocked by proxy policy).

conventions: 同一組「house」機器人模型貫穿全課程：planar2R（L=1,1）、planar3R、rrr3、ur5（皆在 src/mr/robots.ts），其他模型（fiveBar、unicycle、diffDrive、omniBase、planarObject、singleJoint）為該章專用。
顏色：x 紅 / y 綠 / z 藍；{s} 灰、{b} 橘；twist 藍、wrench 紅、奇異構型洋紅；2D 畫布與 Three.js 一致，透過 cssVar 讀取主題變數。
「前乘＝固定座標系、後乘＝物體座標系」是貫穿規則：ch03-01 引入，ch03-03、ch04-02、ch09-02 明確回扣。
反覆出現的迷思各課以一行提醒回扣：『R_ab p 不是轉動 p 而是換座標』、『twist 的 v 不是物體原點速度』、『奇異是構型而非位置的性質』。
每個模擬都要回應 onStep：步驟負責把模擬設成該步談論的狀態（預設組態、顯示／隱藏覆蓋層、鎖定控制項），不要求學習者自己重現設定；但不隨意清除學習者的探索。
每個模擬至少顯示一個可以手算驗證的數值（例如 det R、‖T_space−T_body‖、Grübler 結果、功率 VᵀF）。
數值衛生在課內點名：atan2 而非 atan、θ≈π 的 log 分支、接近奇異的偽逆／DLS、庫侖摩擦死區、Euler 能量漂移、角度包裹、固定子步 RK4。
核心數學一律呼叫 src/mr（exp/log、Adjoint、PoE、Jacobian、IK、Newton–Euler、RK4、時間縮放、控制），課程不自行重新實作；課程專用演算法（A*、RRT、五連桿、位能場、接觸分析）留在課程資料夾並附測試。
測驗規則：每課至少一題遷移題使用模擬中沒出現過的機構或情境；解析要說明「為什麼」，不只標對錯。
節奏：前 1–2 步用具體失敗或現象引起動機，中段建立正式工具，最後一步接到下一課或測驗。
難度標籤：intro / core 組成「核心路徑」，advanced 為延伸；側欄可依此過濾。
文字：台灣繁體中文，英文專有名詞首次出現時以括號保留（例：旋量（twist））；LaTeX 使用 R, p, T, S, V, F, J, M 等標準符號；程式註解英文。
版權：教材僅作為概念與章節編號的參考（bookRef 指向 v2 章節）；所有敘述、題目、圖說皆為原創，不得抄錄或近似改寫。

lessons.title: 自由度與 Grübler 公式（degrees of freedom）
lessons.summary: 學會數出剛體與連桿機構的自由度，用 Grübler 公式快速計算平面／空間機構的 dof，並認得公式失效的特殊幾何。
goals: 說明平面剛體 3 個、空間剛體 6 個自由度的來源（點座標數減去距離約束）
把關節理解為「移除相對自由度的約束」，記住 R/P/H/C/U/S 各保留與移除幾個
對任意平面連桿套用 Grübler 公式，並正確把地面算成一根連桿
辨認公式失效的情況（平行四邊形疊加、冗餘約束）並說出原因

simulation.description: 平面連桿積木：從預設機構（四連桿、曲柄滑塊、五連桿、平行四邊形疊加、三角桁架）出發，或自行放置連桿與 R/P 關節、指定接地桿；側欄即時顯示 N、J、Σf_i 與 Grübler 結果，可拖動自由關節驗證機構真的能動。
controls: 預設機構選單
新增／刪除連桿與關節（R、P）
指定接地桿
拖動關節手把
m=3（平面）／m=6（空間，以範例表呈現）切換
observe: 四連桿 dof=1、五連桿 dof=2、三角桁架 dof=0（手把被鎖住）
在閉環上多加一個關節，dof 反而減少
平行四邊形疊加時公式給 0 或負值，機構卻仍能拖動
pitfalls: 閉環求解器以小步拖動加 warm start 才穩定，避免跳到另一個裝配分支
同一點上接 k 根連桿要算成 k−1 個關節
dof≤0 時鎖定手把並顯示提示，而不是讓畫面亂跳

steps.title: 一個剛體有幾個自由度？
steps.outline: Count a body's freedoms as point coordinates minus distance constraints: 3 in the plane, 6 in space. Introduce dof as the number of independent numbers needed to pin the configuration.
steps.simState: Single free link on an empty canvas; dragging shows (x, y, φ) readout; counter shows N=1, J=0, dof=3.

steps.title: 關節是「拿走」自由度
steps.outline: A joint removes relative freedoms between two bodies rather than adding motion. Table of joints with freedoms f_i and constraints c_i = m − f_i.
steps.simState: Two links; adding an R joint drops dof from 6 to 4, a P joint likewise; the joint table highlights the chosen joint row.

steps.title: Grübler 公式
steps.outline: Derive dof = m(N − 1 − J) + Σ f_i by subtracting constraints from the freedoms of N − 1 moving bodies; stress that the ground link is part of N.
steps.simState: Four-bar preset with formula panel; hovering N, J or Σf_i highlights the matching links/joints.

steps.title: 動手驗證：四連桿、曲柄滑塊、五連桿
steps.outline: Run through presets, predict dof before revealing it, then drag the handles to confirm the count matches actual mobility.
steps.simState: Preset cycle enabled; prediction input appears before the readout is unmasked.

steps.title: 公式失靈的時候
steps.outline: Stacked parallelogram links give dof ≤ 0 yet move: the formula assumes independent constraints. Special geometry adds mobility the count cannot see.
steps.simState: Parallelogram-with-extra-link preset; dof reads 0 with a warning badge, handles still move.

steps.title: 從自由度到組態空間
steps.outline: dof is the dimension of the configuration space; the next lesson asks about its shape, using the 2R arm.
steps.simState: 2R preset; shows (θ₁, θ₂) readout and a small preview of the joint-angle square.

quizIdeas: 給一張課堂上沒看過的六桿機構（Stephenson 型）圖，算 dof 並指出哪一桿是地
空間 RRRS 開鏈末端有幾個自由度？若把末端再接回地面形成閉環呢？
設計題：在平面五連桿上加一個關節，讓 dof 從 2 變回 1，有哪些做法？

lessons.title: C-space 的拓撲與表示法（topology & representation）
lessons.summary: 用 2R 手臂看懂組態空間（C-space）的真正形狀是環面而非方格，並比較顯式座標與隱式表示的取捨。
goals: 區分 C-space（關節空間）與 workspace（末端可達區域）
理解 2R 手臂的 C-space 是 $T^2=S^1\times S^1$，方格只是把環面剪開攤平的表示
比較顯式座標（角度）與隱式表示（單位向量＋約束）的優缺點
能說出平面剛體、球面擺等常見系統的 C-space 拓撲

simulation.description: 三聯動視圖：左為 (θ₁, θ₂) 方格、中為 Three.js 環面、右為 2R 手臂與 workspace 環帶。拖任一視圖的點，其餘同步；畫一條穿越方格邊界的路徑，看它在環面上連續不斷。
controls: 拖 (θ₁, θ₂) 點、環面上的點或手臂末端
畫路徑／清除路徑
切換顯式（角度）與隱式（cos, sin）數值面板
調整 L₁、L₂ 比例
開關「黏合邊界」動畫
observe: 方格左右邊其實是同一條線；環面上沒有邊界
方格中的直線路徑在 workspace 中是曲線
workspace 同一點對應環面上兩個不同點（elbow-up / elbow-down）
L₁≠L₂ 時 workspace 變成有洞的環帶
pitfalls: 每幀以 atan2 重新包裹角度，避免 ±π 跳變讓路徑看起來斷掉
環面上的拖曳要把指標射線投影到曲面，不是投影到方格
黏合動畫用 morph target 由平面漸變成環面，避免重建幾何

steps.title: 工作空間不是組態空間
steps.outline: Two different arm configurations put the tip at the same point. The configuration is the pair of angles, not the tip position.
steps.simState: Right view shows both elbow solutions ghosted for the current tip; left/middle views highlight the two distinct configuration points.

steps.title: 把角度畫成方格
steps.outline: Plot (θ₁, θ₂) in [−π, π]². Dragging the arm traces a point; this is the explicit coordinate representation.
steps.simState: Left square active with trail; middle torus hidden.

steps.title: 黏合邊界：環面
steps.outline: θ = −π and θ = π are the same configuration, so opposite edges are glued; gluing both pairs gives a torus. Topology is about the shape, not the chart.
steps.simState: Glue animation morphs the square into the torus; path crossing the square edge appears unbroken on the torus.

steps.title: 拓撲 vs 表示法
steps.outline: Same torus, two representations: two angles (minimal, but wraps) or four numbers (cos, sin) with two constraints (no wrap, redundant). Each has a cost.
steps.simState: Numeric panel toggles between (θ₁, θ₂) and (c₁, s₁, c₂, s₂) with the constraint residuals shown as 0.

steps.title: 路徑在三個視圖中長什麼樣
steps.outline: A straight path in the square is a curve in the workspace and a geodesic-like curve on the torus; the three views are the same motion.
steps.simState: User-drawn path replayed simultaneously in all three views with a moving marker.

steps.title: 其他系統的 C-space
steps.outline: Planar rigid body R²×S¹, spherical pendulum S², door with knob S¹×S¹. Bridge: constraints on velocity (next lesson) do not change this shape.
steps.simState: Gallery cards (static sketches) replace the right view; torus stays for comparison.

keyEquations: 平面剛體：$\mathcal C=\mathbb R^2\times S^1$
quizIdeas: 一根可自轉的指針固定在球面上滾動，其 C-space 拓撲是哪個？（$S^2\times S^1$）
哪個系統的 C-space 與 2R 手臂同胚：門加門把，還是桌上的硬幣？為什麼？
用 9 個數字描述旋轉卻只有 3 個自由度，這是顯式還是隱式表示？代價是什麼？

lessons.title: 完整／非完整約束、任務空間與工作空間（holonomic, Pfaffian）
lessons.summary: 用俯視的單輪車體會「速度被限制，構型卻沒有被限制」，學會把約束寫成 Pfaffian 形式並判斷可積性，同時釐清 task space 與 workspace。
goals: 把約束寫成 $A(q)\dot q=0$，判斷它能否積分成 $g(q)=0$
解釋為何非完整約束減少的是瞬時速度方向，而不是 C-space 的維度
用停車入位的操作，用兩個輸入到達三維構型的任一點
分辨 task space（由任務定義）與 workspace（由機器人定義）

simulation.description: 俯視圖的單輪車／硬幣：以滑桿或鍵盤給前進速度 v 與轉向率 ω，軌跡畫在地面，側欄顯示 q=(φ, x, y) 與約束矩陣 A(q)。「嘗試側滑」按鈕會畫出被禁止的速度方向；「停車挑戰」要求到達指定的側向位姿。
controls: v、ω 滑桿或 WASD 鍵盤
按鈕：嘗試側滑（顯示違反約束）
停車挑戰：目標位姿與成功判定
切換「平面質點」對照模型
重置軌跡
observe: 兩個輸入卻能到達三維 C-space 的任一點
側向位移需要「前進—轉—後退—轉」的組合
側滑箭頭永遠垂直於允許的速度方向
質點模型可以直接側移，差別一目了然
pitfalls: 位姿積分用精確圓弧（或 exp 於 SE(2)）而不是 Euler，以免長時間漂移
鍵盤輸入要在 destroy() 時移除監聽
停車判定要同時比較位置與角度（包裹到 ±π）

steps.title: 硬幣只能往前滾
steps.outline: The wheel's velocity must point along its heading; sideways motion is forbidden instantly. Yet parking sideways is clearly possible.
steps.simState: Unicycle with heading arrow; 'try sideslip' button draws a red forbidden arrow.

steps.title: 寫成 Pfaffian 形式
steps.outline: Express the no-slip condition as a row A(q) q̇ = 0: ẋ sin φ − ẏ cos φ = 0. One velocity constraint, three coordinates.
steps.simState: A(q) matrix panel shown and updated live with φ; q̇ readout marks which direction is killed.

steps.title: 能不能積分？完整 vs 非完整
steps.outline: A holonomic constraint is the derivative of some g(q)=0 and removes a dimension; the rolling constraint is not integrable so the reachable set stays 3-D.
steps.simState: Side-by-side: pendulum-rod demo (holonomic, state locked to a circle) vs unicycle (reachable cloud fills the plane).

steps.title: 停車挑戰
steps.outline: Reach a pose displaced sideways with only v and ω. The four-move sequence shows how two inputs generate the third direction.
steps.simState: Challenge mode: target pose ghost, success check, optional auto-replay of the four-move sequence.

steps.title: Task space 與 workspace
steps.outline: Task space is chosen by the task (e.g., a pen tip in the plane has 2 or 3 coordinates); workspace is what this robot can reach. They need not match.
steps.simState: Overlay: task-space axes drawn at the vehicle; a gallery card compares a 6R arm's workspace with a 2-D drawing task.

steps.title: 下一步：描述剛體的位姿
steps.outline: To work with real robots we need a precise algebra for position and orientation: rotation matrices and transforms (Ch3).
steps.simState: Vehicle frame {b} and world frame {s} highlighted; readout of the 3×3 planar transform T_sb as a preview.

keyEquations: 完整約束 $g(q)=0\Rightarrow\frac{\partial g}{\partial q}\dot q=0$
quizIdeas: 只能前進後退、在環形軌道上的火車：約束是完整還是非完整？C-space 維度是多少？
焊接任務（末端位置＋焊槍方向）的 task space 維度？用 6R 手臂執行時多出來的自由度會怎樣？
若 A(q) 的每一列都能寫成某個 g(q) 的梯度，可到達的構型集合會是什麼樣子？

lessons.title: 剛體位姿與旋轉矩陣（rotation matrix, SO(3)）
lessons.summary: 從平面座標系暖身到三維旋轉矩陣：把 R 的三個欄位讀成 {b} 軸的方向，理解 R 的三種用途，並建立「前乘＝固定軸、後乘＝物體軸」的規則。
goals: 用 (R, p) 描述 {b} 相對 {s} 的位姿，讀懂下標順序與消去規則
理解 $R_{ab}p_b$ 是「同一點換參考座標」而不只是「轉動向量」
把旋轉矩陣的三欄讀成 {b} 軸在 {s} 中的方向，驗證 $R^{\mathsf T}R=I$、$\det R=1$
預測前乘（固定軸）與後乘（物體軸）合成後的姿態差異

simulation.description: Three.js 場景中的 {s} 與可操作的 {b}。步驟 1–2 鎖定為俯視平面模式（只繞 z 旋轉、xy 平移），之後開放三維。右側矩陣面板即時高亮 hover 的欄位；序列編輯器可堆疊多個 Rot(ω̂, θ) 並切換前乘／後乘。
controls: 平面模式：θ 與 (x, y) 滑桿；拖動一個點看 p_s / p_b 雙欄數值
三維模式：繞 x/y/z 的角度滑桿
序列編輯器：堆疊 Rot，拖曳改順序，前乘／後乘切換
矩陣面板：hover 欄位高亮對應 3D 軸；R^T R 與 det R 讀值
按鈕：顯示 R_bs = R_sb^T 並交換角色
observe: 點不動時，p_b 的數值隨 {b} 的位姿改變
矩陣的欄位就是畫面上 {b} 的三個軸
前乘繞 {s} 的軸轉，後乘繞 {b} 的軸轉；平面可交換，三維不行
手動把欄位改成不正交的數字，立體軸會歪斜變形（不是旋轉）
pitfalls: 不要用 Three.js 的 Euler 順序，直接以矩陣設定姿態
多次合成後以 ProjectToSO3 重新正交化，避免累積誤差
同一畫面同時演示「移動點」與「移動座標系」會混淆，分步顯示

steps.title: 平面暖身：用 (R, p) 描述一個座標系
steps.outline: In the plane a frame {b} is a 2×2 rotation plus a 2-vector\; p_s = R_sb p_b + p_sb. Subscripts read 'b expressed in s'.
steps.simState: Top-down planar mode\; θ and (x, y) sliders\; a draggable point shows p_s and p_b side by side.

steps.title: 同一個點，兩套座標
steps.outline: R_ab p_b does not move the point\; it re-expresses it. Moving {b} changes p_b while the point stays.
steps.simState: Point pinned\; {b} dragged\; p_b numbers update, p_s stays fixed, with a 'same point' badge.

steps.title: 旋轉矩陣的三個欄位
steps.outline: Switch to 3-D: the columns of R_sb are the unit axes of {b} written in {s}. Hovering a column highlights that axis.
steps.simState: Full 3-D mode\; matrix view with column hover → axis highlight.

steps.title: SO(3)：正交、det = 1、三個自由度
steps.outline: Nine numbers, six constraints, three freedoms. det = −1 is a reflection, not a rotation.
steps.simState: Editable matrix cells\; R^T R and det readouts\; invalid matrices draw a skewed, dashed frame.

steps.title: 合成與下標消去
steps.outline: R_ac = R_ab R_bc\; the inner subscripts cancel. The inverse is the transpose, and R_bs = R_sb^T.
steps.simState: Third frame {c} appears\; arrow chain s→b→c\; swap button shows R_bs.

steps.title: 前乘＝固定軸，後乘＝物體軸
steps.outline: Rot(ẑ, 90°)·R spins about {s}'s z\; R·Rot(ẑ, 90°) about {b}'s z. In 3-D the order matters\; try two different rotations swapped.
steps.simState: Sequence editor with pre/post toggle\; ghost frame shows the alternative result for comparison.

steps.title: R 的三種用途與下一步
steps.outline: R is a pose, a change of coordinates, and an operator that rotates vectors. Next: describe rotation by an axis and an angle.
steps.simState: Three-tab demo: pose, re-express, rotate-a-vector\; a preview arrow shows an axis ω̂ for the next lesson.

keyEquations: $R=[\hat x_b\;\hat y_b\;\hat z_b],\quad R^{\mathsf T}R=I,\;\det R=1$
quizIdeas: 已知 {b} 的 ẑ 指向 {s} 的 −x̂，x̂_b 指向 ŷ_s，寫出 R_sb 並求 ŷ_b
飛機先偏航 90° 再俯仰 90°（物體軸），等價於固定軸下的哪個順序？
相機量到 p_c，已知 T_wc；若誤用 T_cw 算 p_w，結果在幾何上代表什麼？

lessons.title: 角速度與旋轉的指數座標（exponential coordinates, Rodrigues）
lessons.summary: 把旋轉看成「繞某軸轉某角」：由角速度導出 so(3)，用 Rodrigues 公式計算 exp，再用矩陣對數反推軸與角，並處理 θ=0、π 的特殊情況。
goals: 理解 $\dot R R^{\mathsf T}$ 與 $R^{\mathsf T}\dot R$ 分別給出 $[\omega_s]$ 與 $[\omega_b]$，兩者是同一向量換座標
用 Rodrigues 公式從 $(\hat\omega,\theta)$ 算 R，並解釋三項各自的幾何意義
由 R 反推 $\log R$，知道 θ 取在 $[0,\pi]$ 且 θ=π 時有兩個軸
分辨指數座標與 Euler 角，知道 3D 角速度不能直接積分成角度

simulation.description: 單位球上可拖的旋轉軸 ω̂ 與一個物體座標系；拖 θ 看物體繞軸轉並留下圓弧軌跡，面板顯示 exp([ω̂]θ) 的三項分解。「反向模式」讓學習者任意旋轉物體，即時計算 log R 畫出軸與角，並以小圖畫出回傳 θ 與輸入 θ 的關係。
controls: ω̂ 拖曳手把（球面）與 θ 滑桿（0..2π）
播放動畫並顯示 ω_s、ω_b 箭頭
反向模式：自由旋轉物體，顯示 log R
按鈕：把 θ 設為 π、設為 0.001 觀察分支
Rodrigues 三項分別開關
observe: ω_s 在空間中固定，ω_b 在物體上固定，兩者由 R 相連
θ 超過 π 時 log 回傳另一條較短的路徑（軸反向）
θ=π 時 ±ω̂ 給同一個 R
關掉 (1−cos θ)[ω̂]² 項後矩陣不再正交，軸會變形
pitfalls: θ≈π 時 (R−Rᵀ)/(2 sin θ) 失真，改由對稱部分取軸（MatrixLog3 已處理）
θ≈0 時用級數分支，避免 0/0
回傳的 θ 曲線在 π 處折返，要在圖上標出

steps.title: 旋轉中的物體：角速度向量
steps.outline: A spinning body has an instantaneous axis and rate\; ω = ω̂ θ̇. Each body point moves with ω × p.
steps.simState: Animation of the frame spinning about a fixed axis\; velocity arrows on the axis tips.

steps.title: ω_s 與 ω_b 是同一個向量
steps.outline: Ṙ R^T = [ω_s] and R^T Ṙ = [ω_b]\; [·] is the skew-symmetric map. ω_b = R^T ω_s.
steps.simState: Two arrows (space and body) drawn\; numeric panel shows both skew matrices updating during playback.

steps.title: 繞固定軸轉 θ：Rodrigues 公式
steps.outline: Solving Ṙ = [ω̂] R with constant axis gives exp([ω̂]θ) = I + sin θ [ω̂] + (1 − cos θ)[ω̂]². Each term has a geometric role.
steps.simState: θ slider scrubs the motion\; term toggles reveal the role of each Rodrigues term.

steps.title: 反向：矩陣對數
steps.outline: Given R, recover θ from the trace and ω̂ from the antisymmetric part\; log returns θ ∈ [0, π].
steps.simState: Reverse mode: drag the frame freely, axis and angle drawn\; θ_in vs θ_out plot shows the fold at π.

steps.title: θ = π 與 θ = 0 的特殊情況
steps.outline: At π the axis sign is ambiguous and the usual formula divides by zero\; at 0 the axis is undefined. Robust code uses separate branches.
steps.simState: Preset buttons jump to θ=π and θ=0.001\; UI badge names which log branch is active.

steps.title: 指數座標不是 Euler 角
steps.outline: ω̂θ is one axis-angle, not three sequential angles\; it also cannot be obtained by integrating ω over time in 3-D. Bridge to twists.
steps.simState: Side panel compares ZYX Euler readout with ω̂θ for the same R\; preview of a translating-and-rotating frame.

quizIdeas: R 的跡為 1，旋轉角是多少？此時能否唯一決定軸？
陀螺儀量到物體座標角速度 ω_b，要在世界座標畫箭頭要乘什麼？
給 ω̂θ = (0, 0, 3π/2)，等價的最短指數座標是？

lessons.title: 齊次變換、旋量（twist）與 Adjoint
lessons.summary: 把 R 與 p 裝進 4×4 的 T 來合成、求逆、換參考系；再把剛體速度寫成六維旋量，理解 V_s 與 V_b 的差異，並用 Adjoint 在座標系之間轉換。
goals: 用 $T\in SE(3)$ 合成、求逆（不是轉置）與改變參考座標系
把 twist 解讀為「角速度＋參考原點處的線速度」，知道 v 不是物體原點的速度
區分 $\mathcal V_s$ 與 $\mathcal V_b$，並用 $[\mathrm{Ad}_T]$ 轉換
把前乘／後乘規則延伸到 SE(3)

simulation.description: 場景中有 {s}、{b}、{c} 三個座標系；滑桿設定 T_sb、T_bc，面板顯示 T_sc 與反矩陣。第二模式讓剛體沿任意 twist 運動，畫出 ω、v 箭頭與瞬時螺旋軸，可切換 V_s / V_b 數值，拖動 {s} 位置觀察 v_s 變化。
controls: 每個座標系的位姿滑桿；下標交換按鈕
按鈕：對 T_sb 前乘／後乘同一個 T
twist 模式：設定 V_b 六個分量並播放
切換 V_s / V_b 顯示；拖動 {s} 原點
顯示 [Ad_T] 分塊與瞬時螺旋軸
observe: 下標消去像箭頭鏈 s→b→c；反矩陣的 p 變成 −Rᵀp
v_s 是「{s} 原點若固連於物體」的速度，可以指向不直觀的方向
換參考系時 ω 只被旋轉，v 多出 p×ω 的耦合
純轉動的 twist 在遠離軸的座標系裡 v 很大
pitfalls: Adjoint 的 [p]R 區塊容易寫錯位置，顯示時標明
學生常把 v_s 當成物體原點速度，同時畫兩支箭頭對照
twist 播放用 exp 積分 T，不用 Euler

steps.title: 把 R 與 p 裝進 4×4
steps.outline: T = [R p\; 0 1] turns rotate-then-translate into one matrix product\; points become homogeneous 4-vectors.
steps.simState: {s} and {b}\; T_sb matrix view\; a point shown with homogeneous coordinates in both frames.

steps.title: 合成、求逆、換參考系
steps.outline: T_sc = T_sb T_bc\; T^{-1} = [R^T −R^T p\; 0 1]. Transpose is not the inverse.
steps.simState: {c} added\; arrow chain\; inverse button\; a 'try transpose' button draws the wrong frame dashed.

steps.title: 前乘／後乘再一次
steps.outline: Pre-multiplying by T acts in {s}\; post-multiplying acts in {b}. Same rule as for R, now including translation.
steps.simState: Pre/post toggle on a fixed T\; ghost frame shows the other outcome.

steps.title: 旋量：角速度加參考原點的線速度
steps.outline: A moving body's velocity is a 6-vector V = (ω, v). v is the velocity of the point of the body (or its extension) at the frame origin.
steps.simState: Twist mode: body translates and spins\; arrows for ω and v at the body origin\; velocity arrows on several body points.

steps.title: V_s 與 V_b
steps.outline: [V_b] = T^{-1} Ṫ (seen from the body) and [V_s] = Ṫ T^{-1} (seen from space). Drag {s} away: v_s changes, ω does not.
steps.simState: Toggle V_s/V_b numeric panel\; {s} origin draggable\; v_s arrow drawn at {s} origin.

steps.title: Adjoint：換座標的 6×6 矩陣
steps.outline: V_s = [Ad_{T_sb}] V_b with [Ad_T] = [R 0\; [p]R R]\; the lower-left block couples rotation into linear velocity.
steps.simState: Adjoint matrix view with block highlighting\; verification readout V_s − Ad·V_b ≈ 0.

steps.title: 預告：每個 twist 都有一條螺旋軸
steps.outline: The instantaneous screw axis of the motion is drawn\; next lesson parametrises it and exponentiates it.
steps.simState: Instantaneous screw axis shown through the scene\; pitch readout.

quizIdeas: 物體繞通過點 q、方向 ŝ 的軸以 θ̇ 純轉，{s} 中的 twist 是什麼？為何 v_s 不為零？
已知 V_b 與固定於物體上的另一座標系 {c}，V_c 與 V_b 的關係是什麼？
兩個物體有相同的 V_s，它們的運動一定相同嗎？

lessons.title: 螺旋運動的指數座標與力旋量（screw motion, wrench）
lessons.summary: 任何剛體位移都是沿某條螺旋軸的一段運動：由 (q, ŝ, h) 建構 S，動畫 exp([S]θ)，再用 log 反推；最後把力與力矩合成 wrench，用 Adᵀ 換座標並確認功率不變。
goals: 由 $(q,\hat s,h)$ 建構螺旋軸 $\mathcal S=(\omega,v)$，含純轉（h=0）與純移（ω=0）兩種退化情況
用 $e^{[\mathcal S]\theta}$ 產生剛體運動，理解任意兩個位姿之間存在唯一的螺旋運動
由 T 取 $\log$ 得回 S 與 θ
把 wrench 視為 twist 的對偶，用 $[\mathrm{Ad}_{T_{ba}}]^{\mathsf T}$ 轉換並驗證 $\mathcal V^{\mathsf T}\mathcal F$ 不變

simulation.description: 可拖的螺旋軸（點 q、方向 ŝ、節距 h）；拖 θ 看座標系沿軸滑動與旋轉並留下螺旋軌跡，面板顯示 exp([S]θ)。反向模式：把座標系拖到任意位姿，顯示 log T 與連接兩位姿的螺旋軸。第二頁：在剛體上一點施力，顯示 {s}、{b} 中的 wrench 與功率。
controls: q、ŝ 手把與 h 滑桿（含 h=0 與 ω=0 純移）
θ 滑桿與動畫；軌跡開關
反向模式：拖物體到目標位姿，顯示 log T 與螺旋軸
wrench 頁：施力點、力向量、力矩；切換 F_s / F_b
twist 滑桿計算功率 Vᵀ F
observe: h=0 時軌跡是圓弧，h 增大愈像直線
任意兩個位姿之間都有一條螺旋軸把它們連起來
同一力在不同座標系的 m 分量不同，功率卻相同
力作用點改變時 m 改變、f 不變
pitfalls: ω=0 的純移動需要分開處理（S=(0, v)，‖v‖=1）
使用 θ 之前把 ω 或 v 正規化
Adᵀ 用的是 T_ba 不是 T_ab，介面上寫清楚

steps.title: Chasles：任何位移都是一段螺旋
steps.outline: Every rigid displacement equals a rotation about some axis plus a translation along it. Show it by connecting two poses.
steps.simState: Two poses (start, end) with the connecting screw axis drawn\; scrubbing θ interpolates.

steps.title: 螺旋軸 S = (ω, v)
steps.outline: From a point q on the axis, direction ŝ and pitch h: ω = ŝ, v = −ŝ × q + h ŝ. Pure translation is the ω = 0 case with ‖v‖ = 1.
steps.simState: Axis handles live\; S readout updates\; pitch slider including the prismatic limit.

steps.title: exp([S]θ) 動畫
steps.outline: MatrixExp6 builds T from S and θ\; the trail is a helix whose slope is the pitch.
steps.simState: Playback with helix trail\; term-wise matrix view of the translation part.

steps.title: 反向：log T
steps.outline: MatrixLog6 recovers S and θ from any T\; special-case ω = 0. The screw interpolation looks natural compared with interpolating R and p separately.
steps.simState: Reverse mode: drag the frame\; screw axis and θ shown\; toggle to compare with naive R/p interpolation.

steps.title: 力旋量 wrench
steps.outline: A force f at point r produces moment m = r × f about the frame origin\; stack them as F = (m, f).
steps.simState: Wrench page: force arrow at a draggable point on a bar\; m and f readouts.

steps.title: 用 Adᵀ 換座標，功率不變
steps.outline: F_a = [Ad_{T_ba}]^T F_b (note the swapped subscript) because power V^T F must be the same in every frame.
steps.simState: F_s/F_b toggle\; twist sliders\; power readout equal in both frames.

steps.title: 下一章：把關節軸當成螺旋軸
steps.outline: Each robot joint is a screw axis\; chaining exponentials gives forward kinematics.
steps.simState: Preview: three screw axes arranged like a 3R arm with the end frame moving.

keyEquations: $\mathcal F_a=[\mathrm{Ad}_{T_{ba}}]^{\mathsf T}\mathcal F_b,\qquad P=\mathcal V^{\mathsf T}\mathcal F$
quizIdeas: 門鉸鏈的螺旋軸參數是什麼？若改成有螺紋的門栓（h≠0）會如何？
手持扳手在 {b} 原點施力 f，{s} 原點在 1 m 外，F_s 的力矩分量從哪裡來？
已知 T₁、T₂，如何找到連接兩者的螺旋軸？為何這樣做出的動畫比分別線性內插 R 與 p 自然？

lessons.title: 指數積公式的空間形式（PoE, space form）
lessons.summary: 把每個關節當成一條螺旋軸，在零位姿寫下 M 與 S_i，用連乘的指數把手臂「組」出來，並理解乘法順序的由來。
goals: 在零位姿（home configuration）定義 M 與各關節的空間螺旋軸 $\mathcal S_i$
理解 $e^{[\mathcal S_1]\theta_1}\cdots e^{[\mathcal S_n]\theta_n}M$ 的順序來自「後面的關節先動、前面的關節帶著它動」
對平面 3R、空間 RRR 與含 P 關節的手臂寫出完整 PoE
說明零位姿不唯一，但換了 M 與 S_i 後 FK 不變

simulation.description: 以空間 RRR（rrr3）為主、平面 3R 與 RRRP 為預設範例的 Three.js 場景：零位姿時畫出每條 S_i，關節滑桿驅動手臂；「逐項套用」按鈕從 e^{[S_n]θ_n} 開始一次乘一項，顯示中間座標系；也可只動單一關節，看下游的軸被帶走、上游的軸不動。
controls: 關節角度滑桿（n 個）
逐項套用／重置的步進按鈕
只動單一關節模式
顯示／隱藏零位姿的 S_i 與目前的關節軸
預設：rrr3、平面 3R、RRRP（SCARA 類）
observe: 公式中的 S_i 固定在零位姿；動了前面關節後它的「實際位置」被帶走
逐項套用時，最後一個關節的指數先作用在 M 上
P 關節的 S 只有 v 分量，軸線畫成虛線方向
換零位姿（例如全部 +90°）後 M 與 S_i 一起變，T(θ) 卻相同
pitfalls: 步進動畫要以反向索引（先 n 再 n−1…）套用因子才符合公式
UI 標明「零位姿定義」避免學生用目前構型的軸當 S_i
Robot3D 的連桿端點來自 homeJointPoints(Slist)，自訂機器人要提供 M

steps.title: 一個關節就是一條螺旋軸
steps.outline: A single revolute joint moves the end frame by exp([S]θ) applied to its home pose M; the axis S is read off at home.
steps.simState: One-joint arm; axis S drawn; θ slider moves M to exp([S]θ)M.

steps.title: 零位姿：寫下 M 與每條 S_i
steps.outline: Set all joints to zero, record the end frame M and each joint axis (ω_i, −ω_i × q_i) in {s}; prismatic axes are (0, v̂).
steps.simState: rrr3 at home; all S_i drawn with labels; M frame highlighted; readout of each S_i.

steps.title: 為什麼是從右邊乘起
steps.outline: Move only joint n: T = exp([S_n]θ_n)M. Then moving joint n−1 carries everything downstream, which is a pre-multiplication in {s}.
steps.simState: Step-through mode applies factors from n down to 1 with intermediate frames ghosted.

steps.title: 動一個關節，看看誰跟著動
steps.outline: The formula's S_i never change, but the physical axis of joint i moves whenever an upstream joint moves. Downstream axes follow, upstream ones stay.
steps.simState: Single-joint mode; current axes drawn solid, home axes dashed.

steps.title: 換個零位姿試試
steps.outline: Redefine home with all joints at +90°: M and all S_i change together, and T(θ) at the corresponding angles is unchanged.
steps.simState: Button 'rehome': new M and S_i computed; a difference readout confirms the same end pose.

steps.title: 平面 3R、RRRP 與下一課
steps.outline: Apply the recipe to the planar 3R and to an arm with a prismatic joint; next lesson rewrites the same product in the end-effector frame.
steps.simState: Preset switcher; formula panel shows the product with the active preset's n.

keyEquations: R 關節：$\mathcal S_i=(\hat\omega_i,\,-\hat\omega_i\times q_i)$；P 關節：$\mathcal S_i=(0,\hat v_i)$
quizIdeas: 把零位姿改為所有關節 +90°，M 與 S_i 哪些改變？FK 會不會改變？

lessons.title: PoE 物體形式、UR5 範例與 URDF（body form）
lessons.summary: 用末端座標系的螺旋軸 B_i 寫出同一個 FK，推導 B_i = Ad_{M⁻¹} S_i，在 UR5 上驗證兩種形式一致，並對照 URDF 的關節描述。
goals: 用 $\mathcal B_i$ 寫出 $T(\theta)=Me^{[\mathcal B_1]\theta_1}\cdots e^{[\mathcal B_n]\theta_n}$，並推得 $\mathcal B_i=[\mathrm{Ad}_{M^{-1}}]\mathcal S_i$
解釋 space form 與 body form 給出相同 T(θ) 的原因（$e^{[\mathcal S]\theta}M=Me^{[M^{-1}\mathcal S M]\theta}$）
在 UR5 的 6R 幾何上讀出 S_i、B_i 並驗證 FK 數值
看懂 URDF 的 joint origin/axis 與 PoE 「全部相對零位姿」描述的差別

simulation.description: UR5 桿狀模型（書中幾何參數 W1, W2, L1, L2, H1, H2）。六個關節滑桿；面板同步顯示 S_i 與 B_i，切換 space / body 計算路徑並顯示兩者差的範數；具名姿態可與手算對照；可展開簡化的 URDF 樹狀圖，點選 joint 高亮對應連桿與軸。
controls: 六個關節滑桿與具名姿態預設
切換 space / body 面板；顯示 ‖T_space − T_body‖
隨機 θ 按鈕
顯示 B_i（黏在末端）或 S_i（固定於 {s}）
URDF 樹狀圖展開與高亮

body form 先乘 M 再連乘：在末端座標系下的運動用後乘
兩式差值在 1e−12 量級（顯示時四捨五入）
URDF joint 的 origin 相對於父連桿，和 PoE 的零位姿描述不同但可互相換算

steps.title: 同一條鏈，從末端看
steps.outline: Express each joint axis in the end-effector frame at home: B_i = Ad_{M^{-1}} S_i. These are fixed in {b}.
steps.simState: UR5 at home; B_i drawn attached to the end frame; S_i dashed in {s}.

steps.title: 為什麼可以把 M 移到最前面
steps.outline: The identity exp([S]θ) M = M exp([M^{-1} S M]θ) lets each factor pass through M, turning pre-multiplications into post-multiplications.
steps.simState: Formula panel animates the factor passing through M one joint at a time.

steps.title: Body form：後乘的順序
steps.outline: T = M exp([B_1]θ_1)…exp([B_n]θ_n): joint 1 is applied first in body coordinates, consistent with the post-multiply rule.
steps.simState: Toggle to body path; step-through applies factors 1..n after M.

steps.title: 在 UR5 上驗證
steps.outline: Read S and B for the six joints from the geometry, compute T for a named pose both ways, compare with the hand calculation.
steps.simState: Named pose preset; both T matrices shown; difference norm readout.

steps.title: URDF 說的是另一種話
steps.outline: URDF describes each joint relative to its parent link with origin and axis; converting to S_i means accumulating along the parent chain.
steps.simState: URDF tree panel; clicking a joint highlights its link and shows the accumulated S_i.

steps.title: 換工具、換零位姿與下一章
steps.outline: Adding a tool changes M and all B_i but no S_i. Next: how joint rates map to end-effector twists (Jacobian).
steps.simState: Tool-offset toggle; B_i readouts change, S_i stay; preview arrow of the end-effector twist.

lessons.title: 空間與物體 Jacobian 的幾何意義（space / body Jacobian）
lessons.summary: 把 Jacobian 的每一欄讀成「該關節在目前構型的螺旋軸」，看懂末端 twist 是各欄乘關節速度的疊加，並用 Adjoint 連結 J_s 與 J_b。

θ̇ 輸入或單關節脈衝按鈕
切換 J_s / J_b 面板與欄位高亮
切換 planar3R / rrr3
顯示各欄對末端速度的分向量

J_b 的欄位在末端座標系看是固定方向的軸，只被後面的關節影響
twist 的 v 不是末端速度；兩支箭頭並列對照

末端點速度另外算 v + ω × p 並標示
高亮欄位時避免每幀重建 matrixView

steps.title: 一次動一個關節
steps.outline: Pulse joint i alone: the end-effector twist is exactly the i-th column of J. The column is that joint's current screw axis.
steps.simState: Pulse buttons; the active joint's axis and the resulting tip velocity arrow highlighted.

steps.title: J_s 的欄位怎麼算
steps.outline: Column i of J_s is S_i transported by the motion of joints 1..i−1: Ad of their exponentials. Column 1 is always S_1.
steps.simState: J_s panel; moving θ₁ visibly shifts columns 2–3, column 1 stays.

steps.title: 疊加：V = J θ̇
steps.outline: With several joints moving, the twists add linearly; the tip velocity is the vector sum of the column contributions.
steps.simState: θ̇ vector input; contribution arrows chained head-to-tail at the tip.

steps.title: J_b：從末端看同一件事
steps.outline: Column i of J_b is B_i transported backwards by joints i+1..n. In {b} the last column is always B_n.
steps.simState: Toggle to J_b; axes redrawn relative to the end frame.

steps.title: 兩個 Jacobian 之間只差一個 Adjoint
steps.outline: J_s = Ad_{T_sb} J_b; same physics, different frame. Verify numerically.
steps.simState: Readout of ‖J_s − Ad·J_b‖ ≈ 0; Adjoint matrix view.

steps.title: v 不是末端速度，以及下一課
steps.outline: The v part of a space twist is the velocity of the point at the {s} origin; the tip velocity is v + ω × p_tip. Next: when J loses rank.
steps.simState: Two arrows (twist v at origin vs tip velocity) labelled; preview of a straightened arm.

keyEquations: $\mathcal V_s=J_s(\theta)\dot\theta,\quad J_{s,i}=[\mathrm{Ad}_{e^{[\mathcal S_1]\theta_1}\cdots e^{[\mathcal S_{i-1}]\theta_{i-1}}}]\mathcal S_i$
quizIdeas: 3R 平面手臂第 3 關節轉動時，J_s 第 3 欄會隨 θ₃ 改變嗎？隨 θ₁ 呢？
要讓末端純平移（ω=0），θ̇ 必須滿足什麼？用 J 的列說明

lessons.title: 奇異點與可操作度橢球（singularity, manipulability ellipsoid）
lessons.summary: 用幾何辨認 Jacobian 降秩的構型，畫出可操作度橢球並解讀長短軸，用條件數量化「離奇異點多近」。
goals: 定義運動學奇異點為 $J$ 降秩，並能用幾何（軸共線、共面）辨識
由 $JJ^{\mathsf T}$ 的特徵分解畫出速度橢球並解讀主軸
用 $\sigma_{\max}/\sigma_{\min}$ 或 $\sqrt{\det JJ^{\mathsf T}}$ 量化接近奇異的程度
說明奇異是關節空間的性質，而不是工作空間的某個位置

simulation.description: 平面 2R／3R 手臂末端畫出速度橢球（由末端線速度子 Jacobian 的 JJᵀ 特徵分解）；底部曲線圖顯示 σ_max、σ_min 與條件數隨構型變化；可開啟 workspace 的 σ_min 熱圖，拖末端逼近伸直或折疊看橢球壓扁。
controls: 拖末端或關節滑桿
切換 2R / 3R（冗餘）
顯示 σ 曲線與條件數
σ_min 熱圖開關
按鈕：跳到奇異構型
observe: 伸直時橢球壓成一條線，徑向速度無法產生
3R 在同一末端位置可能有一個構型奇異、另一個不奇異
條件數在真正到達奇異點之前就已經很大（連續現象）
熱圖的亮暗跟著構型而不是只跟著位置
pitfalls: 橢球只用線速度子 Jacobian，避免混入角速度單位
2×n 的奇異值用 eig2x2Sym(JJᵀ) 即可；σ_min 要 clamp 避免除零
熱圖取樣解析度要與畫布尺寸匹配，離屏渲染一次後快取

steps.title: 伸直的手臂推不動自己
steps.outline: Fully extended, the two joint axes produce parallel tip velocities: no radial motion is possible. J has lost rank.
steps.simState: 2R near full extension; tip velocity arrows for each joint drawn parallel; rank readout.

steps.title: 奇異是構型的性質
steps.outline: The same workspace point can be reached by a singular and a non-singular configuration (3R). Singularity lives in joint space.
steps.simState: 3R mode; two configurations for one tip point, one flagged singular.

steps.title: 可操作度橢球
steps.outline: Unit-norm joint velocities map to an ellipse at the tip whose axes are the eigenvectors of JJ^T scaled by √λ.
steps.simState: Ellipse drawn with principal axes; eigenvalue readouts.

steps.title: 量化：σ 與條件數
steps.outline: σ_max/σ_min and √det(JJ^T) summarise how isotropic the ellipse is. Watch them blow up before the singular pose is reached.
steps.simState: Plot of σ values and condition number versus θ₂ sweep; live marker.

steps.title: 整個工作空間的地圖
steps.outline: The σ_min heatmap over the workspace (for a chosen branch) shows where motion is 'cheap' and where it is not.
steps.simState: Heatmap overlay; branch selector.

steps.title: 接近奇異的代價與下一課
steps.outline: Producing a modest tip speed near singularity demands huge joint rates. Statics flips the picture: the same pose carries loads with little torque.
steps.simState: Readout of required θ̇ for a fixed radial speed as θ₂ → 0; preview of force ellipse.

quizIdeas: 2R 手臂要沿徑向以 0.1 m/s 離開奇異附近，所需 θ̇₂ 如何隨 θ₂→0 變化？
3R 冗餘手臂末端在同一點，找出一個奇異與一個非奇異構型並解釋
6R 腕部三軸交於一點，哪種構型是腕部奇異？對末端姿態速度有何影響？

lessons.title: 靜力學 τ = Jᵀ F 與力橢球（statics, force ellipsoid）
lessons.summary: 用虛功推導 τ = JᵀF，看懂力橢球與速度橢球互為對偶，並解釋為何奇異構型反而適合承受特定方向的負載。
goals: 用功率守恆推導 $\tau=J^{\mathsf T}\mathcal F$，並正確配對座標系（$J_b$ 配 $\mathcal F_b$）
畫出力橢球並說明它與速度橢球的主軸互為倒數
解釋奇異構型下為何能以接近零的力矩承受沿連桿方向的負載
分清 F 是末端對環境施的力還是環境對末端的力，符號會反

simulation.description: 2R／3R 手臂末端可拖出一個外力向量 F；每個關節以弧形寬度與數值條顯示 τ_i；可疊畫速度橢球與力橢球（主軸互為倒數），並有「伸直構型沿連桿施力」的預設。
controls: 拖末端設定構型
拖外力箭頭的方向與大小
切換顯示速度／力橢球
按鈕：伸直構型 + 沿連桿施力
切換 F 的方向約定（施於環境／來自環境）
observe: 速度橢球長的方向，力橢球是短的
伸直構型沿連桿施力時 τ ≈ 0
同一力在不同構型需要的 τ 差很多
功率 θ̇ᵀτ 與 Vᵀ F 相等
pitfalls: 力橢球用 (JJᵀ)⁻¹，接近奇異時要用 drawEllipse2x2 的 inverse 選項並限制軸長
方向約定在 UI 上固定並標示，避免正負號混亂
力矩條要有上限夾制，避免奇異附近爆表

steps.title: 外力到關節力矩
steps.outline: Hold a load at the tip: each joint must supply a torque. Drag the force and watch the torques.
steps.simState: Force arrow draggable; torque bars per joint.

steps.title: 用功率推導 τ = Jᵀ F
steps.outline: Power in equals power out: θ̇^T τ = V^T F for all θ̇, hence τ = J^T F (frames must match).
steps.simState: Power readout for both sides; frame-pairing badge (J_b with F_b).

steps.title: 力橢球
steps.outline: Unit-norm torques map to an ellipse of achievable tip forces; its axes are the reciprocals of the velocity ellipse's.
steps.simState: Both ellipses overlaid; axis-length readouts showing the reciprocal relation.

steps.title: 奇異構型反而能扛
steps.outline: At full extension a force along the links needs almost no torque; the arm acts like a strut.
steps.simState: Preset: straight arm with axial force; torques ≈ 0; ellipse degenerate along the links.

steps.title: 同一個力，不同的構型
steps.outline: Compare torques for the same load in several postures: posture choice is a design decision.
steps.simState: Posture presets with a torque-norm comparison table.

steps.title: 方向約定與下一章
steps.outline: Sign conventions for F (applied to vs. by the environment) flip τ. Next: inverting the kinematics to reach a target pose.
steps.simState: Convention toggle demo; preview of a target pose and two IK solutions.

keyEquations: 力橢球：$\tau^{\mathsf T}\tau\le1\Rightarrow\mathcal F^{\mathsf T}(JJ^{\mathsf T})\mathcal F\le1$
quizIdeas: 人用伸直的手臂撐牆比彎著省力，用橢球解釋

lessons.title: 解析逆運動學：2R 手臂的兩組解（analytic IK）
lessons.summary: 用餘弦定理與 atan2 導出 2R 手臂的 elbow-up / elbow-down 解，判斷可達性與邊界上的單解，並預覽 6R 手臂「位置三關節＋姿態三關節」的分解思路。
goals: 由餘弦定理與 atan2 推出 2R 的兩個解，並說明為何不能用 atan
判斷可達區域（環帶）、邊界上的單解與不可達的情況
拖動目標時維持同一分支，並知道分支何時被迫切換
把 6R PUMA 型手臂的 IK 分解成位置與姿態兩部分的思路說清楚

simulation.description: 拖目標點，同時畫出兩個 IK 解（實線／虛線），workspace 環帶著色，目標落在環帶外時變紅；數值面板顯示餘弦定理的中間量 cos θ₂ 與 atan2 的象限；旁邊的小關節空間圖標出兩個解的位置。
controls: 拖目標點 (x, y)
L₁、L₂ 滑桿
鎖定分支（up / down）並拖目標觀察連續性
按鈕：目標移到環帶外
顯示 atan 與 atan2 的差異
observe: 環帶內兩解、邊界一解、外部無解
拖目標跨過邊界時分支會互換
L₁ ≠ L₂ 時內圓半徑是 |L₁ − L₂|，不是 0
用 atan 取代 atan2 會在後半平面給錯象限
pitfalls: acos 的引數要 clamp 到 [−1, 1]，避免數值略超出時產生 NaN
關節空間小圖要用 wrapToPi 包裹角度
分支鎖定時目標穿越奇異邊界要給提示而不是突然跳解

steps.title: 給一個點，找兩組角度
steps.outline: A target tip point generally has two arm configurations (elbow up/down). IK is the reverse of FK and need not be unique.
steps.simState: Target draggable; both solutions drawn; joint-space inset shows two points.

steps.title: 餘弦定理給 θ₂
steps.outline: cos θ₂ follows from the triangle base–elbow–tip; the sign choice is the branch.
steps.simState: Triangle overlay with side labels; cos θ₂ readout; branch toggle.

steps.title: atan2 給 θ₁
steps.outline: θ₁ is the direction to the target minus the correction angle inside the triangle; atan2 keeps the quadrant right.
steps.simState: Angles drawn as arcs; 'atan vs atan2' toggle shows the wrong-quadrant arm dashed.

steps.title: 可達範圍：環帶與邊界
steps.outline: Reachable iff |L₁ − L₂| ≤ r ≤ L₁ + L₂; on the boundary the two solutions merge into one.
steps.simState: Annulus shaded; target outside turns red; boundary snap shows merged solution.

steps.title: 拖著走：分支與連續性
steps.outline: Following a path with one branch is continuous until the path crosses the boundary or the inner hole; then the branch must switch.
steps.simState: Branch lock on; drag a path through the inner hole; switch warning.

steps.title: 六軸手臂怎麼辦，以及數值方法
steps.outline: PUMA-type arms decouple into a positioning 3R and a spherical wrist (8 solutions). When no closed form exists, iterate numerically (next lesson).
steps.simState: Static diagram card of the decoupling idea; preview of Newton iteration arrows.

quizIdeas: 一條直線路徑穿過內圓，手臂要連續跟隨必須切換分支嗎？

lessons.title: 數值逆運動學：Newton–Raphson 與阻尼最小平方（numerical IK, DLS）
lessons.summary: 把 IK 寫成求根問題，用 log 定義 twist 誤差並逐步執行 Newton 迭代觀察收斂曲線；近奇異點時改用阻尼最小平方，並連結到逆速度運動學。
goals: 把 IK 寫成 $f(\theta)=0$ 的求根問題，用 $\log(T_{sb}^{-1}T_{sd})$ 定義 twist 誤差
逐步執行 $\theta\leftarrow\theta+J_b^{\dagger}\mathcal V_b$，觀察收斂曲線與初值的影響
理解近奇異點時偽逆步長暴增，以及 DLS 用精度換穩定的代價
把逆速度運動學 $\dot\theta=J^{\dagger}\mathcal V$ 與 Newton 步長視為同一件事

simulation.description: 3R 平面手臂加目標位姿（含朝向）。「單步」執行一次 Newton 迭代並畫出手臂軌跡與中間構型；下方曲線圖顯示 ‖ω_b‖、‖v_b‖ 隨迭代變化（對數軸）。可切換偽逆 / 轉置 / DLS 並調整 λ，拖動初始猜測。
controls: 拖目標位姿（位置＋朝向）
初始猜測 θ₀ 滑桿或拖手臂
單步／自動迭代／重置
方法：J⁺ / Jᵀ / DLS；λ 滑桿；最大步長
顯示每次的 Δθ 範數
observe: 好的初值 3–5 步收斂，壞的初值可能發散或收斂到另一個解
遠離奇異時誤差曲線呈二次收斂的陡降
接近奇異時偽逆的 Δθ 暴增，DLS 平滑但收斂變慢
冗餘手臂用 J⁺ 得到最小範數的 Δθ
pitfalls: 誤差要用 log（MatrixLog6 或平面版）而不是 T_sd − T_sb
角度每步包裹，步長要限制（IKinBody 的 maxStep）
目標不可達時要偵測停滯並說明，而不是無限迭代

steps.title: 把 IK 變成求根
steps.outline: Define the residual as the body twist that would move the current end frame onto the target: [V_b] = log(T_sb^{-1} T_sd). IK means driving it to zero.
steps.simState: Target pose and current pose; error twist arrows drawn; residual norms readout.

steps.title: 一步 Newton
steps.outline: Linearise with J_b and solve for Δθ = J_b^† V_b. One click, one step; watch the arm jump closer.
steps.simState: Single-step button; intermediate configuration ghosted; Δθ readout.

steps.title: 收斂曲線與初值
steps.outline: Plot the error norms per iteration on a log axis: quadratic convergence from a good guess, divergence or another solution from a bad one.
steps.simState: Log-scale plot active; initial-guess drag enabled; two example guesses as presets.

steps.title: 奇異附近會發生什麼
steps.outline: Near a singular configuration the pseudoinverse divides by a tiny singular value and the step explodes.
steps.simState: Preset near-singular guess; Δθ spike visible; arm overshoot animation.

steps.title: 阻尼最小平方
steps.outline: DLS replaces J^† by J^T(JJ^T + λ²I)^{-1}: bounded steps at the cost of a biased direction and slower convergence.
steps.simState: Method switch to DLS; λ slider; curves for J⁺ vs DLS overlaid.

steps.title: 冗餘與最小範數解
steps.outline: For 3R positioning only, J is wide; J^† picks the smallest Δθ, leaving the redundant motion untouched. Weighted pseudoinverses change this choice.
steps.simState: Position-only target mode; null-space arrow shown at the elbow.

steps.title: 逆速度運動學與下一章
steps.outline: θ̇ = J^† V is the same formula used continuously; this is how a robot tracks a moving target. Next chapter: closed chains, where FK is the hard one.
steps.simState: Target moves slowly along a path; arm follows with continuous θ̇ = J⁺V; preview card of a five-bar linkage.

lessons.title: 平面五連桿並聯機構：IK 容易、FK 多解（closed chain）
lessons.summary: 以兩顆底座馬達驅動的五連桿為例，體會閉鏈中致動關節與被動關節的區分，IK 可拆成兩個 2R 子問題，而 FK 需解兩圓交點且通常有多個解。
goals: 區分閉鏈中的致動關節與被動關節，寫出迴路閉合（loop-closure）方程式
對 5R 寫出 IK：兩個獨立的 2R 子問題，共四種分支組合
由致動角求 FK：兩圓交點，兩個裝配模式（assembly modes）
用 Grübler 確認 dof=2，並對照 Stewart–Gough 平台的「IK 易、FK 難」

FK 模式：拖兩個馬達角
顯示另一個裝配模式（淡色）
顯示 loop-closure 殘差
調整桿長與底座間距

steps.title: 哪些關節是馬達，哪些是被動的
steps.outline: A five-bar has five joints but only two actuated; the other three follow from loop closure. dof by Grübler is 2.

steps.title: 迴路閉合方程式

steps.title: IK：拆成兩個 2R

lessons.title: 閉鏈的微分運動學與兩類奇異點（actuator / end-effector singularity）
lessons.summary: 把閉鏈的速度關係寫成致動與被動兩塊的約束 Jacobian，區分「鎖住馬達末端仍能動」的致動器奇異與「某方向動不了」的末端奇異，並在五連桿上親手製造。
goals: 由迴路閉合式微分，寫出 $H_a\dot\theta_a+H_p\dot\theta_p=0$ 形式的微分運動學
區分致動器奇異（$H_p$ 降秩、末端多出不受控自由度）與末端奇異（末端失去某方向）
在五連桿上辨認兩類奇異的幾何條件並觀察橢球的行為
說明為何致動器奇異對機構較危險，以及冗餘致動的用處

simulation.description: 五連桿上即時顯示末端速度橢球與兩個約束矩陣的行列式曲線；「鎖馬達」按鈕鎖住兩個致動角後讓學習者用外力拖末端，若仍能微動即致動器奇異；預設按鈕可跳到兩類奇異構型；有限差分 Jacobian 作為對照。
controls: 拖末端或馬達角
按鈕：鎖馬達後嘗試拖末端
顯示 det H_a、det H_p 曲線
預設：致動器奇異／末端奇異構型
切換解析 J 與有限差分 J 對照
observe: 致動器奇異：兩中間桿共線，鎖住馬達末端仍能微動
末端奇異：單邊伸直，末端失去某方向
橢球在致動器奇異時「爆開」而不是壓扁
兩類奇異可能同時發生
pitfalls: 兩類奇異分開示範，再合併
行列式接近零時數值放大要夾制，畫曲線用對數或 symlog
鎖馬達拖末端的「允許位移」以零空間方向投影計算

steps.title: 把閉合方程式微分
steps.outline: Differentiating g(θ_a, θ_p) = 0 gives H_a θ̇_a + H_p θ̇_p = 0. When H_p is invertible the passive rates follow from the actuated ones.
steps.simState: Matrix panel with H_a, H_p and their determinants; live update while dragging.

steps.title: 末端速度橢球
steps.outline: Chain the constraint solution with the tip Jacobian to get tip velocity from motor rates; draw the ellipse like for open chains.
steps.simState: Tip ellipse drawn; motor-rate unit circle shown beside it.

steps.title: 末端奇異：有方向動不了
steps.outline: When one side straightens, no motor combination moves the tip along the lost direction; the ellipse flattens.
steps.simState: Preset: one side straight; ellipse collapses; lost direction drawn.

steps.title: 致動器奇異：鎖住馬達還能動
steps.outline: When the two distal links are collinear, H_p loses rank: with motors locked the tip can still move. The ellipse blows up instead of flattening.
steps.simState: Preset: distal links collinear; lock-motors button; tip drag allowed along the free direction.

steps.title: 為什麼致動器奇異更危險
steps.outline: An uncontrolled degree of freedom means the mechanism can snap to another assembly mode; loads pass through with no actuator authority.
steps.simState: Warning overlay; animation showing a snap-through between assembly modes.

steps.title: 冗餘致動與下一章
steps.outline: Adding a third motor can remove actuator singularities but not end-effector ones. Next chapter: dynamics, where the mass matrix also depends on configuration.
steps.simState: Optional third-motor toggle; det H_p curve no longer crosses zero; preview card of a swinging 2R arm.

keyEquations: 致動器奇異：$H_p$ 降秩；末端奇異：末端 Jacobian 降秩

lessons.title: Lagrangian 動力學與質量矩陣 M(θ)（mass matrix）
lessons.summary: 由動能與位能寫出 2R 手臂的 Lagrangian，導出 τ = M(θ)θ̈ + c(θ, θ̇) + g(θ)，把 M(θ) 讀成隨構型改變的慣量橢圓，並分辨科氏／向心項與重力項的物理來源。
goals: 由 $K$ 與 $U$ 寫出 Lagrangian，並用 Euler–Lagrange 方程導出 2R 的運動方程
把 $M(\theta)$ 讀成關節空間的慣量橢圓，知道它隨構型改變且對稱正定
分辨科氏／向心項 $c(\theta,\dot\theta)$ 與重力項 $g(\theta)$ 的來源與行為
用能量守恆檢查模擬是否可信

simulation.description: 2R 擺臂自由擺動（RK4 固定步長），旁邊畫 M(θ) 的橢圓與能量條（K、U、總能）。可關閉重力、對各項單獨歸零；「固定 θ̇₁」模式顯示 θ₂ 受到的向心力矩；閉式 Lagrangian 結果與 Newton–Euler 函式庫結果並列對照。
controls: 拖初始 θ 與設定 θ̇
開關重力、調整質量與桿長
各項（M、c、g）分別歸零的開關
固定 θ̇₁ 模式，顯示 c(θ, θ̇) 分量
顯示 M(θ) 橢圓與特徵值；能量圖
observe: 伸直時 M 橢圓最長（慣量最大），折疊時最小
無摩擦時總能量在 RK4 下近似平直
θ₁ 等速旋轉會對 θ₂ 產生力矩，即使 θ₂ 不動
關掉重力後 U 消失，擺動變成純慣性運動
pitfalls: 用 RK4 固定子步；Euler 會讓能量明顯上升並誤導學生
質量矩陣橢圓以 M 的特徵分解畫在 (θ̇₁, θ̇₂) 平面，與末端橢球區分
planar2RDynamics 與 buildPlanarChain + InverseDynamics 的差值應顯示為 ~1e−12

steps.title: 讓手臂自己擺
steps.outline: Release the 2R arm and watch it swing. The motion is governed by a differential equation we are about to write down.
steps.simState: Free swing playing; energy bars visible; no controls locked.

steps.title: 動能、位能與 Lagrangian
steps.outline: K is quadratic in joint velocities, U depends on configuration; L = K − U and the Euler–Lagrange equations give the joint torques.
steps.simState: K and U readouts; formula panel with the Lagrangian terms highlighted as the arm moves.

steps.title: 質量矩陣是個橢圓
steps.outline: K = ½ θ̇^T M(θ) θ̇ defines an ellipse in joint-velocity space whose shape changes with θ₂: stretched out when straight, compact when folded.
steps.simState: M ellipse panel; sweep θ₂ to see the ellipse change; eigenvalue readouts.

steps.title: 科氏與向心項
steps.outline: Velocity-product terms appear because M depends on θ: spin joint 1 at constant rate and joint 2 feels a torque even at rest.
steps.simState: Fixed θ̇₁ mode; c(θ, θ̇) components plotted; joint-2 torque bar.

steps.title: 重力項
steps.outline: g(θ) is the gradient of U; it vanishes for a horizontal-plane arm and dominates slow motions.
steps.simState: Gravity toggle; g(θ) bars; horizontal-plane preset.

steps.title: 用能量檢查模擬
steps.outline: Without friction the total energy must stay constant; a drifting energy trace means a numerical problem, not physics.
steps.simState: Energy plot with RK4 vs Euler comparison toggle.

steps.title: 兩種推導，同一個答案
steps.outline: The closed-form Lagrangian result matches the recursive Newton–Euler library call to machine precision. Next lesson builds that recursion.
steps.simState: Side-by-side torque readouts: closed form vs InverseDynamics; difference ≈ 0.

quizIdeas: 哪個構型下用同樣的 τ₁ 能得到最大的 θ̈₁？用 M 橢圓解釋
若 2R 手臂在水平面上運作，g(θ) 變成什麼？c 會變嗎？
花式溜冰收手加速旋轉，對應方程式中的哪一項？

lessons.title: 單剛體動力學與 Newton–Euler 逆動力學（inverse dynamics）
lessons.summary: 先用 twist–wrench 形式寫單剛體方程，再看遞迴演算法如何前向傳遞速度與加速度、後向傳遞 wrench，沿一條軌跡產生各關節的力矩曲線並拆解成慣性、速度與重力貢獻。
goals: 用空間慣量 $\mathcal G_b$ 寫出單剛體方程 $\mathcal F_b=\mathcal G_b\dot{\mathcal V}_b-[\mathrm{ad}_{\mathcal V_b}]^{\mathsf T}\mathcal G_b\mathcal V_b$
解釋遞迴法：前向傳 twist 與加速度、後向傳 wrench，複雜度 O(n)
沿給定軌跡產生 τ_i(t) 並拆成慣性、速度、重力貢獻
說明末端負載如何經由後向遞迴影響所有關節

simulation.description: rrr3 在 3D 場景追蹤一條預設關節軌跡（可調時長）；單步模式逐連桿高亮前向／後向遞迴的中間量（V_i、V̇_i、F_i）；下方圖表疊畫 τ_i(t)，可切換顯示慣性、速度、重力三部分的分解，並可加末端負載與開關重力。
controls: 軌跡預設與時長（快／慢）
單步前向／後向遞迴並高亮連桿
開關重力、設定末端負載 wrench
切換 τ 分解顯示
顯示每個連桿的 V_i、V̇_i、F_i 數值
observe: 軌跡愈快，慣性與速度項愈主導；慢時幾乎只剩重力
末端負載影響所有關節（後向傳遞）
近端關節力矩最大
時長減半時慣性項約變四倍，重力項不變
pitfalls: 空間慣量在質心座標系定義，換座標要用 Adᵀ G Ad
重力向量 g 的座標系要和 Mlist 的 {0} 一致
3D 中 ω × Iω 的 ad 項不可省略

steps.title: 一個剛體：twist 與 wrench 的關係
steps.outline: Stack mass and inertia into a 6×6 spatial inertia; the body wrench equals G V̇ minus a velocity-product term built from ad_V.
steps.simState: Single floating link spinning; F_b components plotted; ad term toggle.

steps.title: 換到別的座標系
steps.outline: Spatial inertia transforms with Ad^T G Ad; the equation keeps its form in any body-fixed frame.
steps.simState: Frame moved off the centre of mass; G matrix view shows off-diagonal coupling appear.

steps.title: 前向遞迴：速度與加速度往外傳
steps.outline: From the base outward, each link's twist is the parent's twist transported plus its joint rate along A_i; accelerations likewise plus a velocity-product term.
steps.simState: Step mode; links highlighted in order 1→n with V_i, V̇_i readouts.

steps.title: 後向遞迴：wrench 往回傳
steps.outline: From the tip inward, each link's wrench is the child's wrench transported plus its own inertial term; the joint torque is its projection on A_i.
steps.simState: Step mode; links highlighted n→1; F_i arrows; τ_i readouts.

steps.title: 沿軌跡的力矩曲線
steps.outline: Run the recursion at every sample of a trajectory to get τ_i(t); decompose into inertial, velocity and gravity parts.
steps.simState: Trajectory playback; stacked τ plots with decomposition toggle.

steps.title: 快一點、重一點
steps.outline: Halve the duration and watch inertial terms quadruple; add a tip load and see every joint respond through the backward pass.
steps.simState: Duration slider and tip-load input; before/after overlay on the plots.

steps.title: O(n) 與下一課
steps.outline: The recursion costs O(n) per call, cheaper than expanding M(θ) explicitly. Next: using these equations forward in time to simulate motion.
steps.simState: Timing readout per call; preview card of forward dynamics integration.

keyEquations: $\mathcal F_b=\mathcal G_b\dot{\mathcal V}_b-[\mathrm{ad}_{\mathcal V_b}]^{\mathsf T}\mathcal G_b\mathcal V_b$

後向：$\mathcal F_i=[\mathrm{Ad}_{T_{i+1,i}}]^{\mathsf T}\mathcal F_{i+1}+\mathcal G_i\dot{\mathcal V}_i-[\mathrm{ad}_{\mathcal V_i}]^{\mathsf T}\mathcal G_i\mathcal V_i,\quad\tau_i=\mathcal F_i^{\mathsf T}\mathcal A_i$
quizIdeas: 把軌跡時長減半，哪些關節力矩約變 4 倍？哪些不變？
手臂靜止但末端有 1 kg 負載，各關節的 τ 由什麼決定？
為何逆動力學可做到 O(n)，而展開 M(θ) 的閉式較貴？

lessons.title: 正動力學與數值積分：Euler vs RK4（forward dynamics）
lessons.summary: 由力矩解出加速度 θ̈ = M⁻¹(τ − c − g) 並積分出運動，比較 Euler 與 RK4 在同一步長下的能量漂移，學會選步長與積分法。
goals: 由 τ 解 $\ddot\theta=M^{-1}(\tau-c-g)$，知道 M 正定所以永遠可解
用 Euler 與 RK4 積分同一系統，觀察步長與積分法對能量漂移的影響
理解閉式方程 $M,c,g$ 與遞迴 Newton–Euler 的關係：用逆動力學湊出正動力學
判斷何時模擬結果不可信（能量發散、爆走）

simulation.description: 2R 手臂正動力學模擬，左右並排 Euler 與 RK4 兩個分身從相同初始狀態出發，下方疊畫兩者的總能量曲線；可調步長 Δt、施加開迴路 τ(t) 脈衝；爆走時自動重置並提示。
controls: 積分法對照（Euler / RK4 並排）與步長 Δt
初始狀態與開迴路 τ(t) 脈衝
開關重力
能量圖；誤差 vs Δt 的小圖
重置
observe: Euler 能量上升發散，RK4 在相同 Δt 下穩定
Δt 太大時兩者都失效
Δt 減半，Euler 誤差約減半，RK4 約減為 1/16
施加 τ 脈衝後兩個分身軌跡迅速分歧
pitfalls: 用 substep 固定子步而不是依賴畫面 dt
|θ̇| 超過上限時重置並顯示警告
誤差 vs Δt 圖用 log–log 才看得出階數

steps.title: 反過來：從力矩算加速度
steps.outline: Rearrange the equation of motion: θ̈ = M^{-1}(τ − c − g). M is positive definite so the inverse always exists.
steps.simState: τ input; θ̈ readout; M, c, g bars.

steps.title: 用逆動力學湊出正動力學
steps.outline: Calling inverse dynamics with zero acceleration gives c + g; calling it with unit accelerations and no gravity builds M column by column.
steps.simState: Panel showing M assembled column by column from InverseDynamics calls.

steps.title: Euler 積分
steps.outline: Advance state with θ ← θ + θ̇Δt, θ̇ ← θ̇ + θ̈Δt. Simple, but energy creeps upward.
steps.simState: Euler twin only; energy trace rising.

steps.title: RK4 積分
steps.outline: Four slope evaluations per step give fourth-order accuracy; the same Δt now conserves energy almost exactly.
steps.simState: Both twins; energy traces overlaid.

steps.title: 步長的代價
steps.outline: Sweep Δt: Euler error is first order, RK4 fourth order; both fail when Δt is too large relative to the fastest dynamics.
steps.simState: Error-vs-Δt log–log plot auto-generated from short runs.

steps.title: 開迴路力矩與下一課
steps.outline: Apply a torque pulse: motion diverges quickly, showing why feedback is needed later. Next: what motors, gears and friction add to the model.
steps.simState: Pulse button; twins diverge; preview card of a geared joint.

keyEquations: Euler 誤差 $O(\Delta t)$，RK4 誤差 $O(\Delta t^4)$
quizIdeas: Δt 減半，Euler 的能量誤差大約如何變？RK4 呢？
若關節被鎖死，正動力學的 M⁻¹ 會發生什麼？
為何能量上升一定是數值問題而不是物理現象？

lessons.title: 致動、齒輪與摩擦（gearing, reflected inertia, friction）
lessons.summary: 把馬達與減速機加進模型：齒輪比帶來 G²J_m 的表觀慣量使動態近似解耦，摩擦模型帶來低速黏滑，並理解高減速比對背驅動性與安全的代價。
goals: 寫出含齒輪比 G 與轉子慣量 $J_m$ 的有效慣量 $M_{\rm eff}=M(\theta)+G^2J_mI$
解釋為何高齒輪比讓對角項主導、耦合相對變弱，但也放大反射慣量與摩擦
區分黏滯摩擦與庫侖摩擦，觀察低速時的黏滑（stick–slip）
用背驅動性與碰撞安全說明協作機器人為何偏好低減速比

simulation.description: 上方：單關節的馬達—減速機—連桿示意圖，可調 G、J_m、摩擦係數，顯示從馬達側與關節側看的慣量；下方：2R 正動力學加入齒輪與摩擦後的響應圖，與無齒輪情況並列，顯示耦合程度指標。
controls: 齒輪比 G 與轉子慣量 J_m
黏滯係數 b 與庫侖力矩 τ_c
施加開迴路力矩脈衝或外力推動（背驅動測試）
切換單關節示意／2R 模擬
顯示 M_eff 的對角／非對角比值
observe: G 愈大，對角項被 G²J_m 主導，耦合相對變弱

庫侖摩擦造成低速時走走停停

反射慣量要用 G² 不是 G

steps.title: 馬達、減速機、連桿
steps.outline: A DC motor spins fast with little torque; a gearbox trades speed for torque by the ratio G. Torque and speed scale oppositely.
steps.simState: Single-joint diagram; motor and joint speed/torque readouts linked by G.

steps.title: 反射慣量
steps.outline: Seen from the joint, the rotor inertia appears multiplied by G². With large G this term dominates the link inertia.

steps.title: 耦合變弱了
steps.outline: Adding G²J_m to the diagonal of M makes the arm behave like independent joints; off-diagonal coupling becomes relatively small.

steps.title: 修正後的逆動力學與下一章

lessons.title: 路徑 vs 軌跡：時間縮放 s(t)（time scaling）
lessons.summary: 把軌跡拆成幾何路徑 θ(s) 與時間縮放 s(t)，比較三次、五次、梯形與 S 曲線的 ṡ、s̈ 特性，並依速度／加速度上限選擇合適的縮放。

steps.outline: The same geometric path can be traversed fast or slow; the trajectory adds a time law s(t) with s(0)=0, s(T)=1.

steps.title: 沿著路徑的一維動力學
steps.outline: Restrict the arm to a fixed path θ(s): the equations of motion collapse to one scalar relation in s, ṡ, s̈ with configuration-dependent coefficients.
steps.simState: Arm on path; m(s), c(s), g(s) plotted along s.

steps.title: 力矩限制變成加速度區間
steps.outline: Each joint's torque bounds give an interval for s̈; the intersection over joints is [L(s, ṡ), U(s, ṡ)].

steps.title: 速度極限曲線
steps.outline: Where L exceeds U no motion is feasible; the boundary is the velocity limit curve. Lower torque limits push it down.
steps.simState: Limit curve drawn; τ_max slider moves it.

steps.title: 最快就是 bang-bang
steps.outline: Time-optimal motion always uses maximal acceleration or maximal deceleration; the only question is where to switch.
steps.simState: Forward and backward integration buttons; curves drawn from both ends.

steps.title: 找切換點
steps.outline: Integrate forward with U and backward with L; where the curves meet (or touch the limit curve) is a switch. Iterate if the forward curve hits the limit first.
steps.simState: Auto-solve animation; switch points marked; resulting ṡ(s) highlighted.

steps.title: 手繪檢查
steps.outline: Draw your own ṡ(s) and see where it violates the interval; feasibility means staying below the limit curve with slopes inside [L, U].
steps.simState: Freehand drawing mode; violated segments coloured.

steps.title: 假設與下一章

steps.simState: Velocity-limit toggle modifies the feasible region; preview card of a C-space obstacle map.

steps.simState: PRM build animation; multiple query pairs answered quickly.

lessons.title: 虛擬位能場與局部極小（potential fields）
lessons.summary: 建構吸引與排斥位能並以梯度下降導航，親手製造局部極小陷阱與震盪，認識導航函數的概念與位能場作為規劃器啟發式的用途。

lessons.title: 誤差動態與單關節 PID（error dynamics, PID）
lessons.summary: 把閉迴路行為寫成誤差的線性微分方程，用阻尼比與自然頻率預測超調與安定時間，觀察 I 項消除穩態誤差的代價與積分飽和。
goals: 把閉迴路寫成誤差 $\theta_e$ 的二階線性方程，並由 $\zeta,\omega_n$ 預測超調與安定時間
區分速度輸入（一階）與力矩輸入（二階）的誤差動態
觀察恆定擾動下 PD 的穩態誤差與 I 項的修正，以及積分飽和（windup）

simulation.description: 單關節慣量＋重力／摩擦＋力矩飽和，PID 控制。即時曲線：θ、θ_d、τ、積分器狀態；可施加階躍、斜坡、正弦目標與擾動力矩；小圖顯示特徵根位置隨 K_p、K_d 移動；可切換速度輸入模式對照。

輸入型態：階躍／斜坡／正弦
擾動力矩與飽和上限
抗飽和（anti-windup）開關

恆定擾動下 PD 留穩態誤差，I 項才歸零
飽和時積分器累積，解除後大幅超調；抗飽和改善

steps.title: 控制就是讓誤差消失
steps.outline: Define θ_e = θ_d − θ and ask how it evolves in time; good control means the error dynamics are stable and fast.
steps.simState: Step response with P only; θ_e trace highlighted.

steps.title: 速度輸入：一階誤差動態
steps.outline: If the joint accepts a velocity command, P control gives θ̇_e = −K_p θ_e: exponential decay with time constant 1/K_p.
steps.simState: Velocity-input mode; exponential fit overlay.

steps.title: 力矩輸入：二階誤差動態
steps.outline: With torque input and PD control the error obeys a mass–spring–damper equation; ζ and ω_n set overshoot and settling time.
steps.simState: Torque-input mode; ζ, ω_n readouts; root-locus inset.

steps.title: 擾動與穩態誤差
steps.outline: A constant disturbance (gravity, friction) leaves a steady-state error under PD; the error is proportional to the disturbance over K_p.
steps.simState: Disturbance toggle; steady-state error marker.

steps.title: 加上積分項
steps.outline: The I term integrates the error until the disturbance is cancelled; too much I causes overshoot and slow oscillation.
steps.simState: K_i slider; error returns to zero; overshoot vs K_i.

steps.title: 飽和與積分飽和
steps.outline: Real actuators saturate; the integrator keeps winding up and causes large overshoot when control authority returns. Anti-windup clamps it.
steps.simState: Saturation limit lowered; windup visible; anti-windup toggle comparison.

steps.title: 多關節會怎樣？
steps.outline: Joints are coupled through M(θ) and gravity; next lesson shows why independent PID struggles and how model-based control helps.
steps.simState: Preview card of a 2R arm sagging under PD.

lessons.summary: 看關節耦合如何讓單關節 PID 在多關節手臂失效，用重力補償消除靜態誤差、用計算力矩法把整個系統線性化並解耦，再評估模型誤差的影響與任務空間控制的差異。

simulation.description: 2R 手臂追蹤一條可調速度的關節軌跡（或任務空間直線），三種控制器可切換（PD / PD+g / computed torque），疊畫追蹤誤差曲線與力矩中前饋／回饋的比例；模型質量可故意加入 ±20% 誤差，並可切換任務空間控制觀察奇異附近的行為。

steps.title: 兩個獨立 PID 的下場
steps.outline: Run per-joint PD on the 2R arm: it sags under gravity and the joints disturb each other during fast motion.
steps.simState: PD controller; static sag visible; tracking error plot.

steps.title: 補上重力
steps.outline: Add the model's gravity torque g̃(θ): static error disappears, but dynamic coupling during motion remains.
steps.simState: PD+g controller; sag gone; fast-trajectory error still coupled.

steps.title: 計算力矩：先抵消，再當線性系統控制
steps.outline: τ = M̃(θ̈_d + K_p e + K_d ė) + h̃ cancels the nonlinear dynamics; ideally each joint's error obeys an independent linear equation.
steps.simState: Computed-torque controller; decoupled error curves; feedforward/feedback split bars.

steps.title: 前饋與回饋各做什麼
steps.outline: Feedforward supplies most of the torque along the nominal trajectory; feedback corrects the residual. Watch the split change with speed.
steps.simState: Split bars during slow vs fast trajectories.

steps.title: 模型不準怎麼辦

steps.title: 任務空間控制與下一課

lessons.title: 接觸運動學與形封閉（contact kinematics, form closure）
lessons.summary: 用接觸法線做一階分析判斷滾動、滑動或脫離，在平面用旋轉中心圖法找出可行運動，並判斷一組無摩擦點接觸是否達成形封閉。
goals: 用接觸法線的 wrench 與物體 twist 的內積做一階分析：$\ge0$ 不穿透，$=0$ 滾動／滑動，$>0$ 脫離
在平面用旋轉中心（CoR）圖法找出多個接觸下的可行運動
判斷一組無摩擦點接觸是否形封閉，知道平面至少 4 個、空間至少 7 個
說明單邊約束只推不拉，以及形封閉與力封閉的差別

simulation.description: 平面多邊形物體與可拖放的無摩擦點接觸。每個接觸在旋轉中心平面畫出 ± 區域，交集顯示可行運動；拖物體嘗試移動時違規會變紅；接觸數足夠且法線配置合適時標示形封閉；「推一下」模式顯示接觸的滾動／滑動／脫離分類。
controls: 拖放接觸點於物體邊緣（自動取法線）
拖物體嘗試移動（違規變紅）
顯示各接觸的 CoR 可行區與交集
推一下：給手指速度，顯示接觸模式
按鈕：自動找最少接觸達形封閉
observe: 平面至少 4 個接觸才可能形封閉
三個接觸總留下可逃逸的旋轉中心
接觸法線全部共點時再多也不閉合
手指速度不同時同一接觸可在滾動／滑動／脫離間切換
pitfalls: 一階分析對曲面接觸可能誤判，先用多邊形
CoR 區域以符號標記（+/−/±）並用交集判斷，避免浮點邊界閃爍
形封閉判定用線性規劃或正係數檢查，避免只靠數接觸數

steps.title: 一個接觸能做什麼
steps.outline: A frictionless point contact pushes along its normal only; the body may roll, slide or break away but never penetrate.
steps.simState: One contact on a polygon; body dragged; normal arrow; penetration flagged red.

steps.title: 一階分析：內積的符號
steps.outline: Compute F_i^T V for the contact normal wrench and the body twist: zero keeps contact, positive breaks it, negative is impossible.
steps.simState: Push mode; finger velocity vs body twist; mode label (rolling / sliding / breaking).

steps.title: 旋轉中心圖法
steps.outline: Every planar twist is a rotation about some centre (or a translation); each contact labels regions of the plane with allowed senses.
steps.simState: CoR overlay for one contact; ± regions shaded.

steps.title: 多個接觸：交集
steps.outline: Feasible motions are the intersection of the contacts' allowed regions; shrink it by adding contacts.
steps.simState: Several contacts; intersection highlighted; remaining escape rotation shown.

steps.title: 形封閉
steps.outline: When no twist survives except zero the body is immobilised by geometry alone: four contacts in the plane, seven in space, with well-spread normals.
steps.simState: Auto-arrange button; form-closure badge; counterexample with concurrent normals.

steps.title: 只推不拉，以及摩擦
steps.outline: Unilateral contacts cannot pull; with friction fewer contacts suffice, which is the next lesson's force closure.
steps.simState: Pull attempt demo; preview card of friction cones.

keyEquations: 一階：$\mathcal F_i^{\mathsf T}\mathcal V\ge0$；$=0$ 滾動／滑動，$>0$ 脫離
形封閉：$\{\mathcal V:\mathcal F_i^{\mathsf T}\mathcal V\ge0\ \forall i\}=\{0\}$
平面需 $\ge4$ 個、空間需 $\ge7$ 個無摩擦點接觸
quizIdeas: 給一個 L 形物體與三個接觸點，判斷它能往哪個方向轉
為何形封閉需要的接觸數在空間變為 7？
設計題：用最少的無摩擦接觸固定一個正方形

lessons.title: 摩擦錐與力封閉（friction cone, force closure）
lessons.summary: 用摩擦係數建構摩擦錐並以邊緣向量近似，判斷兩指抓取是否力封閉（連線落在兩個錐內），並理解力與運動自由度的對偶關係。
goals: 由 $\mu$ 建構摩擦錐，並以邊緣向量近似錐
判斷兩指抓取是否力封閉（連線在雙錐內），以及多指情況的 wrench 錐張滿檢查
說明力封閉只保證「存在抵抗力」，不保證施力足夠
用力與運動自由度的對偶解讀未閉合時剩下的自由運動

simulation.description: 平面物體上放置帶摩擦的指尖，顯示摩擦錐；程式計算所有接觸 wrench 的正錐是否張滿整個平面 wrench 空間（線性規劃或凸包含原點檢查）。拖 μ 看錐張開，拖指尖看閉合條件；可施加外部擾動 wrench 測試，並疊加上一課的 CoR 圖做對偶解讀。
controls: 摩擦係數 μ
拖放指尖位置與數量
顯示兩指連線與錐；wrench 空間凸包圖
施加外部擾動 wrench 測試
切換 μ=0（回到形封閉）
observe: μ 增大錐變寬，更多位置可閉合
兩指連線落在兩錐內 ⇔ 力封閉
力封閉但施力不足時物體仍會滑（擾動測試）
未閉合時剩下的自由運動方向對應無法抵抗的 wrench
pitfalls: 凸包含原點檢查在退化（共線）情況要特別處理
力封閉判斷需求解凸錐張滿，用線性規劃或正係數檢查
邊緣向量近似在 3D 需多邊形錐，本課平面只需兩條邊

steps.title: 有摩擦的接觸
steps.outline: With friction the contact can exert any force inside a cone of half-angle atan μ about the normal.
steps.simState: One finger with cone drawn; μ slider widens it.

steps.title: 兩指抓取的判據
steps.outline: Two frictional fingers achieve force closure iff the line between the contacts lies inside both cones.
steps.simState: Two fingers; connecting line; closure badge toggles as fingers move.

steps.title: 多指：wrench 錐是否張滿
steps.outline: Represent each cone by edge wrenches; force closure means their positive combinations span all wrenches (origin strictly inside the hull).
steps.simState: Wrench-space hull plot; origin marker; closure test readout.

steps.title: 閉合不等於抓得住
steps.outline: Force closure guarantees resisting wrenches exist, not that the fingers supply enough force; apply a disturbance to see slip.
steps.simState: Disturbance wrench slider; slip animation with finger force limits.

steps.title: 力與運動的對偶
steps.outline: Directions the grasp cannot resist are exactly the body's remaining free motions; overlay the CoR map from the previous lesson.
steps.simState: Dual overlay: unresisted wrench direction and the corresponding free twist.

steps.title: 回顧與下一章
steps.outline: Form closure by geometry, force closure by friction; next chapter leaves the arm for wheeled bases.
steps.simState: Summary card; preview of an omnidirectional base.

keyEquations: 力封閉（平面）：$\mathrm{pos}\{\mathcal F_1,\ldots,\mathcal F_j\}=\mathbb R^3$
quizIdeas: 兩指抓圓盤，什麼位置會失去力封閉？
給 μ = 0.3，計算兩指在平行面夾持時的允許偏角
對偶題：若物體仍剩一個自由運動方向，哪類 wrench 無法抵抗？

lessons.title: 全向移動機器人運動學（omniwheel / mecanum）
lessons.summary: 由輪子幾何建立底盤 twist 到輪速的關係 u = H(0)V_b，理解輪速限制如何變成底盤速度的多面體，並比較三輪 omni 與四輪 mecanum。
goals: 由每顆輪子的位置、方向與滾子角寫出 $H(0)$ 的一列，建立 $u=H(0)\mathcal V_b$
理解 $H$ 是 $m\times3$（m 顆輪）：三輪恰定、四輪過定，後者有不一致的輪速組合
把輪速上限映射成底盤速度的多面體，知道全向不等於各方向等速
把底盤 twist 積分到世界座標 $\dot q$

simulation.description: 俯視的三輪 omni 或四輪 mecanum 底盤：以虛擬搖桿給 V_b = (ω, v_x, v_y)，顯示每顆輪子的轉速與滾子方向，旁圖畫出可行速度多面體（輪速上限下的 (v_x, v_y) 切片）；也可反向只驅動一顆輪子看底盤怎麼動。
controls: 搖桿設定 V_b；鍵盤駕駛
切換 omni(3) / mecanum(4)
輪速上限
按鈕：單一輪子驅動
顯示 H 矩陣與每列的幾何標註
observe: 側向移動時 mecanum 輪子對角成對同向
可行速度集合是多面體，不是圓
四輪 mecanum 有一個輪速組合不產生運動（打滑／內耗）
把滾子角都設成 0 會退化成無法側移的車
pitfalls: H 的每列要含滾子角 γ 與輪向 β，常見符號錯誤；提供與手算對照的數值
搖桿輸入映射到 V_b 要夾制在多面體內並提示
軌跡積分用 exp 於 SE(2)

steps.title: 全向底盤能做什麼
steps.outline: Drive sideways, spin in place, or both at once: an omnidirectional base has three chassis freedoms.
steps.simState: Joystick control; trail drawn; wheel speed bars.

steps.title: 一顆輪子的一列
steps.outline: For wheel i at (x_i, y_i) with orientation β_i and roller angle γ_i, the driving speed is a linear function of the chassis twist: one row of H.
steps.simState: Single wheel highlighted; its H row annotated with the geometric terms.

steps.title: u = H(0) V_b
steps.outline: Stack the rows: three wheels give a square H, four give 4×3. Wheel speeds follow from any desired chassis twist.
steps.simState: Full H matrix view; V_b → u computation live.

steps.title: 輪速上限 → 速度多面體
steps.outline: Bounded wheel speeds map to a polytope of achievable chassis velocities; the fastest direction is not always forward.
steps.simState: Polytope plot; joystick clamps to it.

steps.title: 四輪的不一致
steps.outline: With four wheels some wheel-speed combinations correspond to no chassis motion; they only cause slip and wear.
steps.simState: Mecanum; null-space combination button; slip indicator.

steps.title: 積分到世界座標，與下一課
steps.outline: q̇ = R(φ)-rotated V_b; integrate to move on the map. Next: bases that cannot move sideways.
steps.simState: World-frame integration shown with heading; preview card of a differential-drive robot.

quizIdeas: 把 mecanum 的滾子角都設成 0 會變成什麼車？
要讓 mecanum 原地旋轉，四輪速度的符號如何？
為何 4 輪 mecanum 的 H 是 4×3？這意味著什麼？

lessons.title: 非完整機器人：差速、車型與里程計（nonholonomic, odometry）
lessons.summary: 寫出單輪車、差速與車型機器人的控制系統 q̇ = G(q)u，用 Lie bracket 的直覺理解側滑方向為何仍可達（可控性），並由輪子編碼器積分里程計觀察漂移。
goals: 寫出 unicycle、差速、車型的 $\dot q=G(q)u$，並指出各自的輸入限制（最小轉彎半徑）
用四段運動序列（Lie bracket 直覺）解釋為何側向方向雖不能瞬時移動卻可達
由輪子編碼器增量積分里程計（用 SE(2) 的 exp），並觀察漂移如何累積
說明角度誤差如何放大位置誤差

simulation.description: 俯視地圖，鍵盤駕駛差速或車型機器人；真實軌跡與里程計估計軌跡並列，輪子加入滑移雜訊，曲線圖顯示位置與角度誤差隨距離累積。「停車挑戰」要求側向移動 1 m；「Lie bracket」按鈕自動示範四段序列。
controls: 模型：unicycle / diff-drive / car
速度與轉向限制（車型最小轉彎半徑）
輪子滑移雜訊強度
按鈕：重置里程計、播放四段序列、停車挑戰
顯示 G(q) 與目前輸入
observe: 車型無法原地轉，差速可以
來回前進轉向的四段序列產生淨側移
里程計誤差隨距離累積，角度誤差放大位置誤差
兩輪半徑略有差異時里程計沿一個方向彎曲
pitfalls: 里程計用 body twist 的 exp 積分，不是把 Δθ 直接加到 x, y
雜訊用固定種子的 PRNG 便於重現
鍵盤監聽在 destroy 時移除

steps.title: 三種底盤，一種限制
steps.outline: Unicycle, differential drive and car all forbid sideways velocity; the car additionally limits its steering angle.
steps.simState: Model switch; forbidden-direction arrow; min-turning-radius circle for the car.

steps.title: q̇ = G(q) u
steps.outline: Each model is a drift-free control system with two inputs; write G(q) and read off how inputs map to heading and position rates.
steps.simState: G(q) matrix view updating with φ; input readouts.

steps.title: 側向可達：四段序列
steps.outline: Forward, turn, back, turn-back produces net sideways motion; this is the geometric meaning of the Lie bracket of the two input fields.
steps.simState: Auto-play four-move sequence; net displacement vector drawn.

steps.title: 停車挑戰
steps.outline: Move 1 m sideways with the car model; feel the minimum turning radius constraint.
steps.simState: Challenge mode with target pose and success check.

steps.title: 里程計
steps.outline: From wheel encoder increments compute the body twist over Δt and integrate with the SE(2) exponential; compare with the true pose.
steps.simState: Estimated vs true trails; per-step update formula shown.

steps.title: 漂移與下一課
steps.outline: Slip noise and unequal wheel radii make odometry drift, and heading error grows position error with distance. Next: feedback to follow a reference trajectory.
steps.simState: Noise slider; error plots; preview card of a reference path.

quizIdeas: 車型機器人要在窄巷把車頭轉 180°，至少需要幾段運動？
兩輪半徑略有差異，里程計會產生什麼形狀的誤差？
為何差速機器人的里程計更新用 exp，而不是直接加 v·Δt·(cos φ, sin φ)？

lessons.title: 軌跡追蹤回授控制與移動操作（trajectory tracking, mobile manipulation）
lessons.summary: 理解為何直線插值對車型機器人不可行而需要可行參考軌跡，設計前饋＋回授的追蹤控制律並觀察收斂，最後把底盤與手臂合併成移動操作的 Jacobian。
goals: 說明可行參考軌跡的必要性（直線插值對非完整底盤不可行）
設計以機器人座標定義誤差的前饋＋回授控制律，並觀察增益對收斂與振盪的影響
對全向底盤用 twist 誤差的回授（含積分）追蹤參考
把底盤與手臂的貢獻合併成移動操作 Jacobian $J_e=[J_{\rm base}\ J_{\rm arm}]$ 並利用冗餘

simulation.description: 差速（或全向）機器人追蹤參考軌跡（虛線），可加初始誤差與擾動，曲線顯示機器人座標下的 (φ_e, x_e, y_e)；第二頁：底盤＋2R 手臂讓末端沿直線走，顯示 J_base 與 J_arm 的貢獻，並可選擇冗餘解法讓手臂遠離奇異。
controls: 追蹤增益 k₁, k₂, k₃；前饋開關
初始誤差與擾動
參考軌跡：圓／S 彎／停車
切換差速／全向底盤
移動操作頁：冗餘解法選單（最小範數／偏好手臂居中）
observe: 純前饋無法修正初始誤差；純回授追不上快軌跡
增益太大引發側向振盪；角度誤差要包裹
全向底盤的 twist 回授加積分可消除穩態誤差
移動操作時底盤緩慢移動補償手臂可達範圍
pitfalls: 誤差要在機器人座標系定義，世界座標 PID 會失效
參考軌跡必須可行（由同一模型產生），否則追蹤律不成立
移動操作的 J_base 用 Ad 轉到末端座標

steps.title: 參考軌跡要可行
steps.outline: A nonholonomic base cannot follow an arbitrary curve; the reference must come from the same model (e.g., arcs for a car).
steps.simState: Infeasible straight-sideways reference flagged; feasible references listed.

steps.title: 只有前饋會怎樣
steps.outline: Replaying the reference inputs reproduces the path only from the exact start; any initial error persists or grows.
steps.simState: Feedforward only; initial offset; divergence visible.

steps.title: 在機器人座標定義誤差
steps.outline: Express the pose error in the robot frame (φ_e, x_e, y_e) so the control law is independent of heading.
steps.simState: Error frame drawn on the robot; error plots.

steps.title: 前饋＋回授的追蹤律
steps.outline: v = v_d cos φ_e + k₁ x_e, ω = ω_d + v_d(k₂ y_e + k₃ sin φ_e): converges for v_d ≠ 0; tune gains and watch oscillation.
steps.simState: Full controller; gain sliders; convergence from offset.

steps.title: 全向底盤的追蹤
steps.outline: For an omnidirectional base use twist feedback with proportional and integral terms; integral action removes steady-state bias.
steps.simState: Omni mode; K_p, K_i sliders; bias disturbance.

steps.title: 移動操作：底盤加手臂
steps.outline: Stack base and arm columns into one Jacobian for the end-effector twist; the extra freedoms let the base keep the arm away from singularities.
steps.simState: Mobile manipulation page; J_base and J_arm contributions; redundancy resolution selector.

steps.title: 課程總結
steps.outline: From configuration space to a mobile manipulator: every chapter's tool reappears here. Revisit the course map to find weak spots.
steps.simState: Summary card linking back to earlier lessons by id.

quizIdeas: 參考軌跡要求原地側移，差速機器人的追蹤控制會怎樣？
v_d = 0 時上述控制律還能修正 y_e 嗎？為何？
移動操作中底盤＋手臂冗餘，應如何分配使手臂遠離奇異？
